goal: Make the game's interface feel like a high-quality adventure game (Zelda-tier), not a generic web overlay. Right now every surface is the same translucent rounded rectangle with a blur — that is the problem to solve. Give the UI real craft: framed panels with ornamented corners or a border-image frame instead of plain rounded rects, the display face (Cinzel) on headings, buttons and HUD labels, a crest/emblem motif, engraved or gilded edges, and iconography with weight to it. Each iteration, pick the single highest-impact surface (title screen, HUD counter, compass, pause/win panels, control hints, touch buttons) and lift it properly rather than touching everything shallowly. Keep it readable in motion over a bright 3D scene. Hard rules: never weaken, skip or delete a test to make the gate pass; never loosen the thresholds or checks in scripts/ui-gate.mjs, scripts/visual-gate.mjs or tests/perf.spec.js; do not raise the draw-call/triangle budget; the UI must keep working on the plain mobile render path and stay within the 44px touch floor; do not add a runtime dependency or a webfont beyond the two already bundled.
_note: Command gate only, on purpose. A machine cannot judge whether a UI 'feels like Zelda' -- that is taste, and per docs/GATES.md it belongs to a human. What the gate CAN do is hold a craft floor so the loop cannot call generic default styling done: scripts/ui-gate.mjs asserts every major surface carries a real frame treatment (ornament layer / border-image / clip-path / mask, NOT just border-radius+blur), the display face is actually applied, touch targets clear 44px, nothing overflows at 320/390/768/1280, iconography exists, and text on solid surfaces clears 4.5:1. It was checked against the current UI and fails with 8 violations that match the complaint. Its contrast check deliberately skips gradient-backed text rather than report a false failure. Passing this gate means the floor is met, NOT that the UI is beautiful -- run with --human-gate to judge that.

command_gate.command: pnpm build && pnpm test && node scripts/visual-gate.mjs && node scripts/ui-gate.mjs
